1. **P1 — Connections can share a client across tenants.**  
   [endpoint_lease_manager.ex:246](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/mcp/endpoint_lease_manager.ex:246)

   Manager keys use `connection.id` without `tenant_id`. Two tenants with the same connection ID and ownership versions can reuse one generation. A live test with two BEAM servers confirmed that tenant B received tenant A’s tool result. Revocation also affects both tenants.

   **Correction:** Include tenant identity in record, generation, and ownership-barrier keys. Carry that identity through lifecycle APIs.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.
title: Connections can share a client across tenants
